findings.title: Support the pinned local engines real German replacement list without silently truncating it
findings.summary: The real saved de-DE reply for Das ist ein Feler. from the pinned LanguageTool6.9-SNAPSHOT contains31 replacements for GERMAN_SPELLER_RULE. parse_reply rejects every issue with more than20 replacements. A normal German misspelling therefore becomes provider_error under the current proposal, and its expected positive actual-DE test cannot establish the intended behavior with that response.
findings.consequence: German analysis incorrectly reports an unavailable/incomplete provider result for this ordinary valid engine response rather than retaining the complete issue and allowing dictionary/recheck behavior.
findings.required_change: Use an explicitly documented, evidenced finite replacement count contract that admits the pinned engines observed valid31-item list while retaining every returned suggestion. Preserve the4MiB provider/aggregate and8MiB result ceilings and per-string limits. Update the schema/contract/tests consistently; do not silently slice the suggestions or turn the rejection into a clean zero.
findings.required_regression: Save a rights-safe actual pinned German response fixture or equivalent complete31-item literal fixture, assert the entire list and exact issue span are retained, then assert a response above the new declared finite count remains an explicit error. Root must later run the real-engine DE spelling/dictionary-recheck test.
findings.basis: Independent data-only parse/hash/schema/span inspection of Root-provided saved synthetic engine responses plus source predicate review. The product parser itself was not executed and the failed Root V3 pilot is not promoted to product acceptance.
